# NEXORA Salon OS

> NEXORA Salon OS helps salon, spa and beauty businesses explore customisable website templates and manage their online presence.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/): Explore NEXORA and all public salon website templates.
- [Salon website templates](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/#nexora-template-library): Compare example designs and choose a starting point.
- [Hair salon website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/hair-salon.html)
- [Barber shop website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/barber.html)
- [Beauty parlour website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/beauty-parlour.html)
- [Nail studio website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/nail-studio.html)
- [Unisex salon website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/unisex-salon.html)
- [Hair spa website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/hair-spa.html)
- [Skincare clinic website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/skincare-clinic.html)
- [Makeup studio website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/makeup-studio.html)
- [Massage and wellness website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/massage-wellness.html)
- [Hair colour website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/hair-coloring.html)
- [Bridal lounge website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/bridal-lounge.html)
- [Tattoo studio website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/tattoo-studio.html)
- [Lash and brow website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/lash-brow.html)
- [Ayurvedic spa website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/ayurvedic-spa.html)
- [Men's hair studio website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/mens-hair-studio.html)
- [Aurelia beauty parlour website template](https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/template-pages/aurelia-beauty-parlour.html)

## Notes
- Template service categories are examples. Owners customise business information, services, prices and imagery before publishing.
- Published salon sites remain available through their existing `/<slug>` and `/?site=<slug>` routes.
- Sign-in and account pages are not public documentation: https://studioflow-ashen-pi.vercel.app/login
